data.description:
Validate the Sprint 4 CLI expression query integration.

## Validation Checklist

### 1. Smoke Test
```bash
python scripts/got_utils.py validate
python -m pytest tests/smoke/ -v --tb=short
```

### 2. CLI Command Tests
```bash
# Help displays correctly
python scripts/got_utils.py expr --help

# List functions works
python scripts/got_utils.py expr --list-functions

# List fields works
python scripts/got_utils.py expr --list-fields --type task

# Basic query works
python scripts/got_utils.py expr "status = 'pending'" --count

# AND query works
python scripts/got_utils.py expr "status = 'pending' AND priority = 'high'"

# NOT query works
python scripts/got_utils.py expr "NOT status = 'completed'" --count

# JSON output works
python scripts/got_utils.py expr "status = 'in_progress'" --format json

# Explain works
python scripts/got_utils.py expr --explain "status = 'pending' AND priority = 'high'"
```

### 3. Integration Tests
```bash
pytest tests/integration/test_got_cli.py::TestExpressionQueryCommands -v
```

### 4. Design Document Alignment Check
- Verify implementation matches docs/design/got-query-audit-and-design.md Sprint 4 requirements
- Key checks:
  - [ ] CLI → Expression Parser → Query Builder → Execute flow
  - [ ] --list-fields implemented
  - [ ] --list-functions implemented
  - [ ] --explain implemented
  - [ ] Integration tests present and passing

### 5. Code Review Points
- cortical/got/cli/query.py: cmd_expr and helper functions
- scripts/got_utils.py: imports and VALID_COMMANDS
- tests/integration/test_got_cli.py: TestExpressionQueryCommands

## Success Criteria
- All CLI commands execute without error
- All 13 integration tests pass
- Output matches expected formats
data.title: Validate Sprint 4 CLI Integration
